overview_description.description:
Tranch helps businesses pay for invoices through new flexible payment infrastructure. The company offers a checkout experience that allows businesses to choose how they pay for large invoices and put their growth first. Find out more at www.tranch.com about how we simplify and accelerate accounts receivable for enterprises with the most innovative workflows and payment solutions.

Tranch is located in New York City and was founded by Beau Allison and Philip Kelvin in 2021.

about_short_description.short_description: Tranch is the invoice to payment platform for enterprises who want to optimize cashflow by offering clients an unparalleled experience.

product.name: Pay Later
product.description: Allows clients to pay invoices in installments up to $500,000 with no credit risk to the vendor.

product.name: Pay Now
product.description: Processes instant payments via ACH, FedNow, and Faster Payments for immediate invoice settlement.

product.name: Pay by Card
product.description: Enables PCI-compliant card payments and virtual card terminals for telephone and online payment acceptance.

product.name: AR Automation
product.description: Automates invoice delivery, payment reminders, tracking, and collections directly from ERP systems to streamline accounts receivable.

product.name: Recurring Payments
product.description: Enables automated setup and collection of recurring fees such as subscriptions and retainers from clients' bank accounts or cards.

product.name: Credit Insights
product.description: Provides AI-driven credit analysis and internal collaboration tools to improve receivables management decisions.
